title: Runner multi-repo phase 2: PYTHONPATH-based stage subprocess loading
problem: Runner stages today are launched as `python -m runner.X` from cwd=worktree. Python loads the runner package from the worktree's runner/ directory (since cwd is on sys.path), which means SCRIPT_DIR resolves inside the worktree and artifacts (specs/plans/executions/hardens/reports) get written under <worktree>/runner/. This works only because the target repo IS apiary — apiary's runner/ travels with every worktree because every worktree branches off apiary's master. For a non-apiary target repo there is no runner/ package to import, so the current invocation pattern breaks entirely. Phase 1 introduces target-repo-aware worktree creation but does not touch how stages are launched; without phase 2 the stage subprocess will fail to start the moment the target is not apiary.
description: Modify runner.run.run_stage so the stage subprocess is invoked with PYTHONPATH=<apiary_repo_root> in its environment, in addition to the existing cwd=<worktree> argument. Python will then locate the runner package via PYTHONPATH regardless of cwd, so SCRIPT_DIR consistently resolves to apiary/runner/ and artifact paths (specs/plans/executions/hardens/reports/logs) consistently land in apiary/runner/ regardless of which target repo's worktree is the cwd. Update run_detached's artifact-path map to root paths at apiary/runner/ instead of <worktree>/runner/ — the worktree no longer needs (and for non-apiary targets cannot have) a runner/ subtree. Verify that the existing apiary-self runner path still works end-to-end: the apiary REPO_ROOT is just a special case of `target_repo`. Phase 1's target_repo resolver is a prerequisite. Phase 3 (target-repo CLI flag + intake field) and Phase 4 (auto_plan prompt rule stripping) build on this.
scope: runner/run.py: run_stage env injection, run_detached artifact-path remap, any executor-side path assumptions surfaced by the change. runner/test_orchestrator.py and runner/test_run_detached.py coverage for the new env shape. Verify full runner suite passes (~836 tests). Acceptance: a runner pass on apiary-self produces specs/plans/executions/hardens/reports under apiary/runner/<dir>/<uuid>.json (NOT under .runner-worktrees/<branch>/runner/<dir>/), and the worktree's runner/ subtree is no longer touched by stage subprocesses. OUT OF SCOPE: introducing the --target-repo CLI flag (phase 3), stripping apiary-specific rules from auto_plan (phase 4), changing executor.py's branch/git semantics, changing how budgeter/log_agent_cost.py is invoked.
context: Part of the runner multi-repo rearchitecture epic agreed in session 27d1126d (2026-04-16). The full epic has 4 phases: phase 1 (target-repo resolver + git_worktree_create plumbing, in-session live work), phase 2 (this ticket — PYTHONPATH-based stage loading), phase 3 (CLI flag + intake field plumbing), phase 4 (auto_plan prompt rule stripping). Phases must land in order — phase 2 depends on phase 1 landing first; phase 3 depends on phase 2 because the stages have to be loadable from apiary before a non-apiary target makes sense.
